sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 13739 of 2023
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Pushpendra Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Haya Rizvi Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

1. Heard Sri Pushpendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr.Ahmad Faran, learned Advocate holding brif of Ms.Haya Rizvi, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Brijesh Pratap Singh, learned AGA for the State.
2.

The present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in F.I.R./Case Crime No.0469 of 2018 under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 323, 504, 506, 120-B IPC, Police Station-Kotwali Dehat, District-Bulandshahr, with a prayer to enlarge him on anticipatory bail during trial.

3. At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant submits that he does not want to press the instant anticipatory bail application on merit and a direction may be given to the court concerned that if applicant appears before it and applies for bail then his bail application shall be dispose off in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Breau Chaman @ Chamanpal Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60014658/
1 of Investigation and another (2022) 10 SCC 51.
4.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Breau Chaman @ Chamanpal Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA is not having any objection if any such direction is given to the court concerned.
5. I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

6. Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA, in case applicant appears before the court concerned within two weeks from today and applies for bail in the instant matter, then his bail application shall be disposed off by the court concerned in view of the law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
7.
The instant anticipatory bail application stands disposed off accordingly.

Order Date :- 17.1.2024 LN Tripathi  Chaman @ Chamanpal Singh vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60014658/
